standard_prerequisites.name: The preadditive structure on the localization
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies that the localization of a preadditive category at a left or right multiplicative system carries a preadditive structure for which the localization functor is additive.

standard_prerequisites.name: Additive functors preserve zero objects and direct sums
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies that an additive functor transforms zero objects to zero objects and direct sums to direct sums, which transports the additive structure of the source to the localization.

core_obligations: The preadditive structure (proof lines 2090-2092): the cited lemma gives that the localization is preadditive and that the localization functor is additive.

Additivity (proof lines 2093-2094): since the functor is additive, the cited lemma on additive functors shows that the localization has a zero object and direct sums, which together with preadditivity is exactly additivity of the localization; the functor is additive by the first step.
proof_roadmap: Get the preadditive structure and additivity of the functor from the preceding lemma.
Transport the zero object and the direct sums along the additive functor.
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that localizing an additive category at a left or right multiplicative system produces an additive category with an additive localization functor (statement lines 2082-2088). The proof is a complete argument: the preceding lemma provides the preadditive structure and the additivity of the localization functor, and the two remaining ingredients of additivity, a zero object and binary direct sums in the localization, are obtained by transporting them from the source category along the additive functor (proof lines 2090-2094). The non-formal content is the observation that additivity of the functor transports the zero object and the direct sums. The claim is H2: a structured argument with each input named.
